raw:
The user wants UI strings for a settings page in Traditional Chinese (繁體中文). The page is: computer peripheral settings: adjust pointer device (mouse/trackpad) movement speed, and display device brightness.

They need:
- "s1": label for pointer device speed
- "s2": label for display brightness
- "s3": title of this settings page

Output only a JSON object with keys s1, s2, s3, string values, no other text.

Traditional Chinese strings:

s1: "指標速度" or "游標速度" or "指標裝置速度". In Taiwan's Traditional Chinese, mouse pointer is usually "游標" (cursor) or "指標". Windows Traditional Chinese uses "滑鼠指標速度" or "游標速度". Common: "指標速度". Given the requirement says "指標裝置速度的標籤" — it's the label for pointer device movement speed. "指標速度" is concise for a label. Could be "游標速度".

s2: "亮度" or "顯示亮度". Label for display device brightness: "亮度" or "螢幕亮度". Since it says 顯示裝置的亮度, "顯示器亮度" or just "亮度". "螢幕亮度" is common in Taiwan. But 顯示裝置 could be monitor. "亮度" is simplest. Maybe "顯示器亮度".

s3: Title of the settings page: could be "周邊設定" or "裝置設定" or "電腦周邊設定". Hmm. The page adjusts pointer speed and display brightness — peripherals. Title: "滑鼠與顯示器設定"? Or "周邊裝置設定"? The description says "電腦周邊設定頁". A title like "裝置與顯示設定" or "周邊裝置". I'd go with "周邊裝置設定" or "裝置設定".

Keep it clean. Output:

{
  "s1": "指標速度",
  "s2": "顯示器亮度",
  "s3": "周邊裝置設定"
}

Wait — "亮度" label alone might be too generic; since s2 is the label for display device brightness, "亮度" suffices in a section context, but "顯示器亮度" is clearer. The instruction: "顯示裝置亮度的標籤" — label for display device brightness. "螢幕亮度" is common in Taiwan usage. "顯示器亮度" also fine. I'll use "螢幕亮度"? 顯示裝置 = display device = 螢幕/顯示器. In Traditional Chinese (Taiwan), "螢幕" is colloquial, "顯示器" is more formal. I'll use "螢幕亮度" — actually for settings UI, "亮度" under a "顯示" header is common. But standalone, "螢幕亮度" is safe.

For s1, "指標速度" — could also be "滑鼠速度". The spec says 指標裝置, which covers mouse and trackpad. "指標速度" is good; Windows uses "游標速度" in Taiwan. I'll use "指標速度".

s3: Title. "周邊裝置設定" seems right. Or "裝置與顯示器". I'll go with "周邊裝置設定".

Output only JSON, no other text.</think>{"s1": "指標速度", "s2": "螢幕亮度", "s3": "周邊裝置設定"}
